summary.en: SpaceX announced that it had acquired xAI in an all-stock transaction on February 2, 2026. Independent reporting valued the combined company at about $1.25 trillion, bringing xAI's Grok models and AI infrastructure into the aerospace company's corporate structure.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 2 月 2 日，SpaceX 宣布通过全股票交易收购 xAI。独立报道估计合并后公司价值约 1.25 万亿美元，xAI 的 Grok 模型和 AI 基础设施由此被纳入这家航天公司的企业结构。

narrative.en: xAI's official announcement stated that SpaceX had acquired the AI company. Bloomberg independently reported a combined valuation of about $1.25 trillion. The transaction joined frontier-model development and the Colossus computing infrastructure with SpaceX's capital-intensive aerospace operations. Because both companies were controlled by Elon Musk, independent coverage also raised questions about related-party valuation, governance, and concentration. The later June acquisition of Cursor is recorded as a separate event.
narrative.zhHans: xAI 的官方公告称 SpaceX 已收购这家 AI 公司。Bloomberg 独立报道合并后估值约为 1.25 万亿美元。该交易把前沿模型开发和 Colossus 计算基础设施与 SpaceX 的资本密集型航天业务结合起来。由于两家公司都由 Elon Musk 控制，独立报道也提出了关联交易估值、公司治理和集中度问题。6 月对 Cursor 的后续收购被记录为独立事件。

description.en: The acquisition concentrated frontier AI models, computing infrastructure, and aerospace-scale capital within one corporate group.
description.zhHans: 这项收购把前沿 AI 模型、计算基础设施和航天级资本集中到同一个企业集团中。

description.en: The transaction linked an AI laboratory and its compute buildout directly to an aerospace company, illustrating cross-sector consolidation around AI infrastructure.
description.zhHans: 该交易把一家 AI 实验室及其算力建设直接连接到一家航天公司，体现了围绕 AI 基础设施的跨行业整合。

text.en: SpaceX announced that it had acquired xAI on February 2, 2026.
text.zhHans: SpaceX 于 2026 年 2 月 2 日宣布已收购 xAI。

text.en: The acquisition combined frontier AI development and large-scale computing infrastructure with SpaceX's aerospace operations.
text.zhHans: 此次收购将前沿 AI 开发和大规模计算基础设施与 SpaceX 的航天业务结合起来。

text.en: The transaction's long-term competitive effects and related-party governance implications remained uncertain.
text.zhHans: 该交易的长期竞争影响和关联方治理影响仍不确定。

sources.quote: SpaceX announced today that it has acquired xAI.

changeLog.summary: Split the February SpaceX-xAI acquisition from the June Cursor transaction while preserving the original L1 editorial judgment.
